qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree as a subject, B.Ed
qualification.details: Mathematics Teacher (TGT): Bachelor's Degree with Mathematics as a subject from a recognized University/Institution, B.Ed. from a recognized institution and CTET Paper-II, as prescribed. State TET may be considered where permitted under the applicable NESTS guidelines. Hindi Teacher (TGT): Bachelor's Degree with Hindi as a subject from a recognized University/Institution, B.Ed. from a recognized institution and CTET Paper-II, as prescribed. State TET may be considered where permitted under the applicable NESTS guidelines. Music Teacher: Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution, with Music as the principal/special subject, as applicable. Fine Art / Art Teacher: Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Drawing & Painting/Sculpture/Graphic Art/Visual Art or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution. Physical Education Teacher (PET): B.P.Ed./Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education or Physical Education & Sports with the prescribed professional qualification, as applicable under NESTS norms.

salary_details.details: Mathematics Teacher (TGT) & Hindi Teacher (TGT): ₹33,000/- per month for candidates possessing the prescribed qualification; ₹29,000/- where the prescribed qualification is not fully met, subject to NESTS norms. Music Teacher, Fine Art / Art Teacher, Physical Education Teacher (PET): ₹33,000/- per month where engaged under the applicable TGT/guest-teacher framework; otherwise as approved by the competent authority under NESTS guidelines.

content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Mathematics Teacher (TGT), 1 for Hindi Teacher (TGT), 1 for Music Teacher, 1 for Fine Art / Art Teacher and 1 for Physical Education Teacher (PET).

Fine Art / Art Teacher: Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Drawing & Painting/Sculpture/Graphic Art/Visual Art or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution. Physical Education Teacher (PET): B.P.Ed./Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education or Physical Education & Sports with the prescribed professional qualification, as applicable under NESTS norms.

content_sections.heading: EMRS Tamenglong Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Mathematics Teacher (TGT) & Hindi Teacher (TGT): ₹33,000/- per month for candidates possessing the prescribed qualification; ₹29,000/- where the prescribed qualification is not fully met, subject to NESTS norms. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for EMRS Tamenglong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for EMRS Tamenglong Recruitment 2026 is 04 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the mentioned address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Teaching Staff (TGT/Guest) posts in Eklavya Model Residential School Tamenglong for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for EMRS Tamenglong Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for these positions is Rs. 33,000 Per Month, with a potential variation based on qualification fulfillment.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post and include Bachelor's Degrees in relevant subjects like Mathematics, Hindi, Music, Fine Arts, and Physical Education, along with B.Ed. and CTET Paper-II where applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for EMRS Tamenglong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview and a demonstration of teaching skills.
